triggers.detailsText: The airline arranged an alternative flight for the passengers, which took off from Hyderabad at around 5.45 pm. The airport now handles 2.3 crore passengers a year with growth at nearly 2.4% against a capacity of 3 crore. That should change by April 2027, with the capacity climbing to 3.5 crore when Terminal 1 will handle 1 crore passengers a year , 1.6 crore in Terminals 2 and 3 together after work finishes, and another 90 lakh at Terminal 4, an AAI official said.
